Hidden In Plain Sight#002.src: You ask the raccoon about its day.
Hidden In Plain Sight#002.dst: Du fragst den Waschbären, wie sein Tag war.

Hidden In Plain Sight#003.src: It opens its mouth as it gasps for air. Suddenly it stops and continues to run around anxiously... Interesting...
Hidden In Plain Sight#003.dst: Er öffnet das Maul und schnappt nach Luft. Plötzlich hält er inne und rennt dann ängstlich weiter... Interessant...

Hidden In Plain Sight#005.src: Maybe you can gain its trust by feeding it.
Hidden In Plain Sight#005.dst: Vielleicht gewinnst du sein Vertrauen, wenn du ihn fütterst.

Hidden In Plain Sight#006.src: Perhaps the nearby crop storages could help you.
Hidden In Plain Sight#006.dst: Vielleicht helfen dir die Getreidelager in der Nähe.

Hidden In Plain Sight#007.src: You meet eyes with the raccoon, it gapes at you with hunger.
Hidden In Plain Sight#007.dst: Du begegnest dem Blick des Waschbären, er starrt dich hungrig an.

Hidden In Plain Sight#008.src: Maybe you can help the raccoon. Look nearby, there could be some excess supplies.
Hidden In Plain Sight#008.dst: Vielleicht kannst du dem Waschbären helfen. Such in der Nähe nach übrigen Vorräten.

Hidden In Plain Sight#009.src: You try scaring the raccoon, it doesn't seem to be affected... Weird...
Hidden In Plain Sight#009.dst: Du versuchst, den Waschbären zu erschrecken, doch es lässt ihn kalt... Seltsam...

Hidden In Plain Sight#011.src: The raccoon swiftly snatches the seeds from you!
Hidden In Plain Sight#011.dst: Der Waschbär schnappt dir blitzschnell die Samen weg!

Hidden In Plain Sight#012.src: It's running somewhere! You should follow the raccoon.
Hidden In Plain Sight#012.dst: Er rennt irgendwohin! Du solltest dem Waschbären folgen.
